name: Task Form
implementation_notes: Task Form shares its two API endpoints (POST /api/tasks, PATCH /api/tasks/:id) and its Vue component (TaskForm.vue) with the Task List screen, which implemented them first — no new BE routes or FE components were needed for this screen.

Fixed a spec-compliance gap in updateTask(): it previously checked title === '' || title === null without trimming, so a whitespace-only title incorrectly passed validation on edit. Now mirrors createTask()'s trim-based check.
frontend/src/components/TaskForm.vue required no changes — already trims title client-side, unifies Cancel/X/Escape/click-outside into one dismiss handler, and disables Save while submitting.

Whitespace-only-title integration test was added only for POST /api/tasks (per tech spec's test_scenarios); the existing PATCH 'title cleared to empty string' integration test already exercises the same trim fix for edit.

known_issues.description: deleteTask/changeTaskStatus in task-service.js use raw string error-code literals instead of ERROR_CODES.* constants — unrelated to this screen's spec, pre-existing from Task List implementation, left as-is.
